description: Windows Update through the Windows Update Agent API: scan, install (never reboots), feature updates to a target Windows 11 release (e.g. 26H2), WSUS/Intune detection, settings that block updates (including an unresponsive WSUS server), logs of failed updates, component store repair, freeing disk space (download cache, Disk Cleanup, component cleanup).

install.description: Download and install the selected updates (no reboot)

cleanup.description: Free space on the system drive: Windows Update download cache, Disk Cleanup (update cleanup, temporary files), DISM /StartComponentCleanup

repair.description: Repair the component store (DISM /RestoreHealth) and system files (SFC), optionally resetting the Windows Update cache

logs.description: Logs that explain failed updates: events, CBS.log errors, services, blockers

feature_update.description: Move Windows 11 to a newer release (e.g. 25H2 to 26H2): feature update or enablement package, no reboot
